```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r Load libraires}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
```


```{r Reading in a file}
getwd()

phys = read_xlsx("/Users/MegHemmerlein/OneDrive - Colostate/MtBlueSky-Workshop/Workshop-Sessions/Introduction-to-Coding/altitude_workshop_data_4participants.xlsx")

str(phys)

phys$Date = as.Date(phys$Date, format = "%m/%d/%y")
phys$Elevation = as.factor(phys$Elevation)
phys$State = as.factor(phys$State)
phys$Participant = as.factor(phys$Participant)

phys$Time_Elevation = paste0(phys$Date, "_", phys$Location)
phys$Time_Elevation = as.factor(phys$Time_Elevation)

```


```{r Exploring the data}
str(phys)

colnames(phys)
```


```{r Indivial physiology in the field}
phys %>%
  filter(Variable == "Heart_Rate") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Time_Elevation, y = Value, color = Participant, group = Participant)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Rested" = "solid", "Excerise" = "dashed")) +
  facet_wrap(~ State) +
  labs(color = "Participant", shape = "State", linetype = "State") +
  ggtitle("Heart Rate (beats/min)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r Group physiology in the field}
vars <- c("Heart_Rate", "Breathing_Rate", "SpO2", "Borg_RPE", "Lake_Louise_Score")

summary_stats <- phys %>%
  filter(Variable %in% vars) %>%
  group_by(Variable, State, Time_Elevation) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop")

summary_stats %>%
  filter(Variable == "Heart_Rate") %>%
ggplot(aes(x = Time_Elevation, y = mean, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - sd,
        ymax = mean + sd),
    width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ State) +
  labs(
    x = "Time/Elevation",
    y = "Heart Rate (beats/min)",
    title = "Mean Heart Rate ± SD"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

summary_stats %>%
  filter(Variable == "Breathing_Rate") %>%
ggplot(aes(x = Time_Elevation, y = mean, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - sd,
        ymax = mean + sd),
    width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ State) +
  labs(
    x = "Time/Elevation",
    y = "Breathing Rate (breaths/min)",
    title = "Mean Breathing Rate ± SD"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

summary_stats %>%

ggplot(aes(x = Time_Elevation, y = mean, group = 1)) +

summary_stats %>%

summary_stats %>%

ggplot(aes(x = Time_Elevation, y = mean, group = 1)) +
```

```{r Group acclimatization}

phys %>%
  filter(Variable == "Heart_Rate") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = Value, color = Participant, 
             shape = State, linetype = State)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Rested" = "solid", "Excerise" = "dashed")) +
  facet_grid(Participant ~ Elevation) +
  labs(color = "Participant", shape = "State", linetype = "State") +
  ggtitle("Heart Rate (bpm)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
